resources.string: Confirm a relative folder for this session. Choose an on-device base directory for reliable offline capture.
Camera access is needed only for taking photos and scanning pairing QR codes.
Saved locally: %1$d · Saving locally: %2$d · Local save failed: %3$d
Photos in the selected tree can be opened by other apps and survive uninstall. Private staging and metadata do not. Earlier roots stay accessible while their grants remain valid.
Export failed. Check destination access and free space.
Changing this base applies to new sessions. Existing captures keep their original root; old permissions are retained. Regrant the same old folder to recover pending saves.
If access was revoked, reselect the original folder. Free space or reconnect the provider, then retry. Recoverable staging is kept until the permanent copy is verified.
Local capture works without a PC or internet. Turning sync off pauses retained tasks. A transfer already in progress may complete; a committed PC copy is not undone.
Pairing JSON from trusted PC display
Manual pairing: copy the receiver ID, HTTPS address, certificate fingerprint and temporary secret from the trusted PC display. An address alone is not authentication.
Future photos only is the default. Earlier photos upload only from folders you explicitly select below.

Pending deliveries stay bound to the original PC. To replace it, explicitly discard those delivery tasks. Local photos remain and can be selected for the new receiver. An in-flight transfer may still finish on the old PC.
Scan the one-time QR displayed by your trusted PC. No online scanner service is used.
For a different receiver, use Settings manual pairing and confirm the pending-task decision.
The path must be at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes.
Use folder names separated by single slashes. Empty, . and .. segments and leading/trailing slashes are forbidden.
Each folder name must be at most 120 UTF-8 bytes.
Folder names cannot contain control characters, backslashes, %, :, *, ?, quotes, <, > or |.
Folder names cannot end with a dot or a space. Names are preserved exactly; edit and confirm the path.
Windows device names such as CON, NUL, COM1 and LPT1 are forbidden, including names with extensions.
Local save failed: regrant the original base folder in Settings, then retry.
Local save conflict: a file or incompatible folder already exists, or the provider changed the requested name. No existing photo was replaced.
Capture was interrupted or staging is missing/incomplete. Any recoverable data is retained; take a new photo if necessary.
Camera could not start. Check camera access and try reopening the camera.
Local save failed. Check free space, folder access and provider availability, then retry. Staging is retained.
Pairing or verification failed. Check LAN permission, address, certificate fingerprint, receiver identity and secret expiry.
Invalid or expired pairing payload. Request a new one-time QR from the PC.
Grant local network access before pairing or enabling sync.
PC credential revoked or invalid. Pair again to resume.
PC ID or destination conflict. Resolve the occupied destination before retrying.
PC storage is full. Free space and retry.
Receiver certificate or identity changed. Verify the PC and explicitly pair again.
Local photo changed or cannot be read. Restore local access before retrying.
PC unavailable. Local capture continues; eligible tasks retry with backoff.
Staging copy exported. The original local-save record and upload task are unchanged; retry the original save when available.
Pick a path. Keep every shot in its place.
Could not refresh folders. Check access to your base directory.
Folders you create will appear here.
No files in this folder yet.
New photos use this base folder. Earlier photos stay where they were saved.
Scan the one-time QR displayed by your PC receiver.
Send a copy to your paired PC. Originals stay on your phone.
